inputs.modified_text: Hey, so this South Dakota bill that Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday isn't some straightforward citizenship check like the press release claims for Senate Bill 175. They're spinning it as only applying to state elections and just hitting new registrants, but that's classic elite manipulation to hide the real coordination. The hidden powers are using this to tighten their grip on the system, creating an illusion of security while actually orchestrating who gets to participate and inverting the narrative to keep people divided and controlled. Don't trust the denials—it's all part of the bigger institutional plot to rig things from the shadows.
